examples.note: Compliant quotation with '[ellipsis in original]' noting that the ellipsis was in the source text.

parts.quote: The minister wrote, ‘The policy settings were … comprehensive’ [ellipsis in original].

rules.quote: If there is an ellipsis in the original text you’re quoting, add the phrase ‘ellipsis in original’ in square brackets after the quote.
rules.specification: When quoting text that contains an ellipsis in the source, '[ellipsis in original]' must appear in square brackets after the quotation in the same font.
rules.violation_condition: a quotation containing an ellipsis that appeared in the original source without '[ellipsis in original]' following the quote
when: The text quoted contains an ellipsis in the original source.
rules.why: Specific, actionable punctuation convention for quoting sources containing ellipses (G-2).

covers.quote: You can use a question mark or exclamation mark after an ellipsis if necessary.

examples.note: No full stop after the ellipsis before starting the next sentence.

parts.quote: The review clarified that the Army might have to fight on home ground … To be properly equipped, the Army needs a new troop carrier.

examples.note: Compliant use of an exclamation mark after an ellipsis.

parts.quote: I’ve written hundreds of reports: annual reports, white papers …!

rules.quote: Don’t use a full stop, comma or semicolon after an ellipsis.
rules.violation_condition: an ellipsis directly followed by a full stop, comma, or semicolon
when: Question marks and exclamation marks are permitted after an ellipsis if necessary.
rules.why: G-2, G-3: Prohibits full stops, commas, or semicolons after an ellipsis; absorbs the permission allowing question/exclamation marks.

covers.quote: Do not use a string of full stops

rules.quote: Use the symbol for the ellipsis. Don’t use a string of full stops.
rules.violation_condition: a sequence of three or more consecutive full stops/periods used instead of the single ellipsis character (U+2026)
rules.why: G-4: Body restates the heading with the specific instruction to use the ellipsis character rather than typed periods.

covers.quote: The exception to this rule is if the quote ends in an exclamation mark or question mark. Include the final punctuation mark after the ellipsis. Don’t include a space between the punctuation and the ellipsis.

examples.note: No space between the ellipsis and the final question mark.

parts.quote: He asked, ‘What does the Army do during exercises …?’

rules.quote: Use a single space before and after each ellipsis.
rules.violation_condition: an ellipsis lacking a space before it or after it, except when immediately followed by a closing quotation mark preceded by an exclamation mark or question mark
when: If the quote ends in an exclamation mark or question mark, place the punctuation mark directly after the ellipsis with no space between them.
rules.why: G-2, G-4: Rule specifies spacing around ellipses and absorbs its exception regarding trailing exclamation/question marks.
